post.description:
`environment` names the environment to run in; `simulator` is the older way to name a prebuilt one (an
owner-published image registered as a version of its environment). With neither, and no
`environment_version`, the environment is inferred from the classes the documents name
(docs/plan-environment-composition.md, step 7a): the shared environment for everything it provides, as before;
otherwise the smallest offered environment that provides them all.
`environment_version` picks a version of that environment (docs/plan-environment-versions.md); the run is labelled
`environment_version=<environment>@<number>` either way.

The run is labelled `source=upload` and `environment=<simulator or registry_env>`; `tags` and `description` are
stored with it as given (compose_api/simulation/labels.py) and filter `GET /simulations`.

CatalogEntry.title: CatalogEntry
CatalogEntry.description:
A registry entry as the catalog shows it (docs/plan-sedml.md, "Concepts"): what it is, how far it is trusted,
and which of this deployment's environments provide its classes. Most `listed` entries are in none.

close.title: Close
close.description: every compared data set close, every member completed

Comparison.title: Comparison
Comparison.description:
One SED-ML task run on several solvers. `result` is filled once every member has finished: per report and
data set label, each solver pair's score and whether it is close.

ComparisonSeries.title: ComparisonSeries
ComparisonSeries.description: One report's columns from each member (by solver) and each reference (by origin), for overlays.

ComplianceCase.title: ComplianceCase
ComplianceCase.description:
One compliance case of an entry, run in a version: `pending` until its run finishes, then `passed`, `failed`
(an expectation not met) or `error` (the run did not finish).

ComplianceReport.title: ComplianceReport
ComplianceReport.description:
What certifies a version's entries (docs/plan-environment-composition.md, step 5): their cases' runs there,
and the generic checks over its components. A component that fails a check is refused in this version (`refused`),
whatever its entry's level.

CurationLevel.title: CurationLevel
CurationLevel.description: The curation ladder, lowest first. Order matters: comparisons use the declaration order.

capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.description: What the caller may do beyond what anyone may, by name (environments:admin, suites:curate, simulations:read-all), computed by the checks that enforce them; the server still checks every request

Dataset.title: Dataset
Dataset.description: A file a run produced, readable by anyone who may read its simulation (O7).

Drift.title: Drift
Drift.description: One solver's result against its own result in the suite's baseline run.

EntryCompliance.title: EntryCompliance
EntryCompliance.description:
An entry's standing in a version: `tested` when its cases all passed there, `pending` while any runs,
`failed` when one did not pass, `untested` when it has no cases yet.

EntryEnvironment.title: EntryEnvironment
EntryEnvironment.description: An environment that provides some of a registry entry's classes, and how many.

EntryRef.title: EntryRef
EntryRef.description: The registry entry a component belongs to (by module root), and its curation level.

EnvironmentExport.title: EnvironmentExport
EnvironmentExport.description:
A version's environment as files to recreate it with locally (docs/plan-environment-composition.md, C2a):
`pixi` (pixi.toml and pixi.lock, `pixi install --frozen`) for a composed version, `requirements` (the uv lock,
`uv pip install -r`) for a shared one.

EnvironmentImage.title: EnvironmentImage
EnvironmentImage.description:
A built or pulled image of a simulator's definition (docs/plan-environment-builds.md, E3).

Images are write-once (E4): one that turns out missing is marked unavailable, never replaced in place.

simulator.title: Simulator

default_source.title: Default Source
default_source.description: deployment: the deployment's own definition is the default; api: an administrator chose it

EnvironmentVersions.title: EnvironmentVersions
EnvironmentVersions.description: An environment's versions, newest first, and which one a run that names none gets.

ErrorDetail.title: ErrorDetail
ErrorDetail.description: An error, as ``HTTPException(status_code, detail="...")`` writes it.

ref.title: Ref
ref.description: A simulation's or a comparison's id; a suite run as `<suite>@<number>`

removed.title: Removed
removed.description: It was starred, and is not now

text.title: Text
text.description: The module's header file (`module …;` and one declaration per class)

build.description: The newest build run of the definition

ImageStatus.title: ImageStatus
ImageStatus.description: Whether a simulator's image is there to run from, and the records behind that answer.

InterfaceComponent.title: InterfaceComponent
InterfaceComponent.description: One step or process class, as `pbg-interfaces/1` describes it; unknown keys pass through.

InterfaceManifest.title: InterfaceManifest
InterfaceManifest.description: An environment's interface manifest (`pbg-interfaces/1`), with each component's registry entry added.

category.title: Category
category.description: what kind of problem, e.g. VCell's fault names (NONINTEGER_STOICH, DELAY)

seen_run.title: Seen Run
seen_run.description: the suite run it was first seen in

cleared_run.title: Cleared Run
cleared_run.description: the suite run that showed it fixed

KnownProblem.title: KnownProblem
KnownProblem.description:
A known problem of one solver on one source of a suite (docs/plan-known-problems.md): excused in the suite's
runs numbered below `cleared_run` (every run while it is open). No solver: the whole source is excused.

KnownProblemClear.title: KnownProblemClear
KnownProblemClear.description: Clear a known problem: the suite run that shows it fixed. Runs before it still excuse it.

KnownProblemEdit.title: KnownProblemEdit
KnownProblemEdit.description: A new category or reason for a known problem; what is not given stays.

seen_run.title: Seen Run
seen_run.description: the suite run it was first seen in

KnownProblemMark.title: KnownProblemMark
KnownProblemMark.description: A known problem to record: the source and solver (none for the whole source), and why.

NewEnvironmentVersion.title: NewEnvironmentVersion
NewEnvironmentVersion.description:
What to make a version from. A composed environment (one that lists its registry entries): a date to resolve
its entries at (default now); a mash-up is an environment of its own, never a version of another. A prebuilt one:
its image by digest. (Library lists, the shared uv path's `custom` versions, are retired:
docs/plan-environment-composition.md, D8.5; versions made that way stay readable.)

NoTaskAccepted.title: NoTaskAccepted
NoTaskAccepted.description: A SED-ML archive none of whose tasks any solver accepted, with the translation's findings.

PackageChange.title: PackageChange
PackageChange.description: A package added (``before`` None), removed (``after`` None) or at another version between two versions.

Rejection.title: Rejection
Rejection.description: A document refused at submission: the addresses it may not use, and why (`registry.validation`).

RunEvent.title: RunEvent
RunEvent.description: One structured event of a run, from the API, the job script or the simulator's engine.

RunEventPage.title: RunEventPage
RunEventPage.description:
A page of a simulation's events, in the order they were recorded.

``next_cursor`` is the ``after`` for the next page, None at the end.

RunSpan.title: RunSpan
RunSpan.description: A node of a run's trace tree, folded from ``span.start`` / ``span.end`` events. ``end_ts`` is None while open.

RunTraceTree.title: RunTraceTree
RunTraceTree.description: A simulation's spans as a forest, each span carrying its own events.

SedmlFinding.title: SedmlFinding
SedmlFinding.description: A finding of the translation (process-bigraph-lang's `X4xx`) or of the checker on a solver's instance.

SedmlRunError.title: SedmlRunError
SedmlRunError.description: A SED-ML run refused: a message, the refused addresses, or the findings when no task was accepted.

refused.title: Refused
refused.description: the solvers refused by an error finding

SedmlTask.title: SedmlTask
SedmlTask.description: One SED-ML task: its translation's template text, the solvers that accept it, and its reports and plots.

SimulationCancellation.title: SimulationCancellation
SimulationCancellation.description:
A cancellation accepted. ``withdrawn``: the run was taken off the queue before SLURM had it, and is cancelled
now. Otherwise SLURM was asked to cancel ``slurm_job_id``, and the run's status reads ``cancelled`` once the job
monitor sees SLURM report it.

mine.title: Mine
mine.description: The caller submitted it, signed in; its owner is never named (docs/plan-favorites-and-studies.md)

environment_version.description: The environment version it ran in; none for a run from before versions

SimulationDetail.title: SimulationDetail
SimulationDetail.description: A simulation with what its run recorded.

environment_version.description: The environment version it ran in; none for a run from before versions

SimulationSummary.title: SimulationSummary
SimulationSummary.description: One simulation as a listing shows it: what ran, where, and how it went (its latest SLURM job).

versions.title: Versions

SimulatorDetail.description: A simulator with its container definition.

versions.title: Versions

run_count.title: Run Count
run_count.description: How many runs you can read used it

SimulatorSummary.title: SimulatorSummary
SimulatorSummary.description:
A simulator (a container definition, identified by its hash) as runs used it (docs/plan-webapp-admin.md, 5c).
One recorded before environment versions is no version's, and is reached only this way.

algorithms.title: Algorithms
algorithms.description: KiSAO terms it implements, its default first

SpanTree.title: SpanTree
SpanTree.description: A span with its own events (those whose ``span_id`` is the span's) and its children, by start time.

SubmissionError.title: SubmissionError
SubmissionError.description: A run refused: a message, or the refused addresses.

SubmissionInfo.title: SubmissionInfo
SubmissionInfo.description: Where a run is on its way to SLURM (docs/plan-durable-submission.md): the detail behind `submitting`.

SubmissionState.title: SubmissionState
SubmissionState.description:
Where a run is on its way to SLURM (docs/plan-durable-submission.md, Q1). The public status stays
``submitting`` until the run has a SLURM job; this is the detail behind it.

baseline.title: Baseline
baseline.description: the accepted suite run that later runs are compared with

verify.title: Verify
verify.description: check comparisons against biosim's /verify once they finish: those that differ, are incomplete or have no reference that agrees (failing), or every one (docs/plan-verify-oracle.md, D3)

environment_versions.title: Environment Versions
environment_versions.description: The environment versions its runs use, {environment: number}; empty for runs started before suites named them (theirs got the default)

expected.title: Expected
expected.description: why the whole source is excused, if it is

known_problems.title: Known Problems
known_problems.description: each solver's known problem here, by solver: its reason

excused.title: Excused
excused.description: the row fails or differs only through solvers with a known problem; the others agree

resolved.title: Resolved
resolved.description: solvers with a known problem here that completed and agree: clear it

oracle_agrees_with.title: Oracle Agrees With
oracle_agrees_with.description: our solvers the newest completed verification agrees with (V5)

environment_versions.title: Environment Versions
environment_versions.description: The environment versions its runs use, {environment: number}

queued.title: Queued
queued.description: comparisons a verification was queued for

already.title: Already
already.description: comparisons with a verification already queued or running

running.title: Running
running.description: comparisons still running, not yet looked at

SuiteVerifyResult.title: SuiteVerifyResult
SuiteVerifyResult.description: Verifications queued for a suite run's comparisons.

Tolerances.title: Tolerances
Tolerances.description:
The platform's closeness score: close when `max |a-b| / (atol + rtol*|b|) < 1`, with
`atol = max(abs_tol_min, max|a|*abs_tol_scale, max|b|*abs_tol_scale)` (docs/plan-sedml.md, D4).

UnprocessableError.title: UnprocessableError
UnprocessableError.description: A 422 a route raises itself (a message), or FastAPI's validation of the request (a list of issues).

ValidationIssue.title: ValidationIssue
ValidationIssue.description: One of FastAPI's request-validation errors (its ``HTTPValidationError`` items).

verify_close.title: Verify Close
verify_close.description: BioSimulators' simulators agree on every report

agrees_with.title: Agrees With
agrees_with.description: our solvers whose every scored data set is close to each of its simulators' (once completed)

failed_simulators.title: Failed Simulators
failed_simulators.description: simulators whose runs at biosimulations.org produced no results

Verification.title: Verification
Verification.description:
One request to biosim's /verify API about a comparison: the archive the comparison ran, on BioSimulators'
simulators (docs/plan-verify-oracle.md). Once `completed`, each simulator's reports are a reference on the
comparison, and `verify_close` says whether the simulators agree with each other.

simulators.title: Simulators
simulators.description: `name` or `name:version`; by default the service's (amici, copasi, pysces, tellurium, vcell)

VerifyRequest.title: VerifyRequest
VerifyRequest.description: Which BioSimulators simulators to verify a comparison with (docs/plan-verify-oracle.md, V4).

VersionRef.title: VersionRef
VersionRef.description: An environment version as a link: its environment's current name and its number (``registry_env@5``).

Visibility.title: Visibility
Visibility.description: Who may read a simulation and everything it produced (plan-observability O7).

VisibilityChange.title: VisibilityChange
VisibilityChange.description: ``PATCH /simulations/{id}``'s body: who may read the run.

VisibilityChanged.title: VisibilityChanged
VisibilityChanged.description:
What a visibility change changed: the run, and the other runs of every comparison it belongs to, which change
with it so a comparison is never half private.

BearerAuth.description: Optional Auth0 access token for this API. Omit it to call anonymously.
